newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-JORDAN MARVELS AT HIS OWN HEROICS.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-JORDAN MARVELS AT HIS OWN HEROICS.

text.p: Even Michael Jordan, whose buzzer-beater won Game 1 of the NBA Finals Sunday, marvels that he is able to come through when everybody in the world knows his Chicago Bulls are counting on him in the clutch.

"I can't really fathom the idea that everybody's watching the game, on TV and in the building, they know that you're going to get the ball, they know you're going to get the shot, and yet you're able to come through in that situation," Jordan said after the 84-82 win over the Utah Jazz.
"I don't want to be put in that situation too often, but when I am, I want to be successful."
